pairs.registryProposal: Missing pairing: webhook-ingestion (767b2bb5-4662-4be1-ad24-c881ac334016) owns src-tauri/src/engine/smee_relay.rs, the native side of this context's stream, and is not paired with native-shell-integration. Judged in passing it would be a native-owned-stream deviation: src-tauri/src/engine/smee_relay.rs:315 awaits stream.next() with no idle timeout derived from the producer heartbeat (the reqwest client at :254 sets no read timeout), so a half-open connection stalls forever while status reports connected:true; and the backoff reset at :49 keys on connection lifetime, not on a round that produced a frame. Add the pair and judge it.
